component: language_model (Qwen3ForCausalLM, 36 layers, hidden 4096, 32 q / 8 kv heads, head_dim 128, vocab 200000)
stage: optimize (stage 07) - supersedes the stage-02 llm_backbone entry

usage_contract.batch_rows: row 0 = conditional prompt, row 1 = unconditional (CFG) prompt; identical positions
usage_contract.prompt_plus_frames_bound: prompt <= 5000 and frames <= 9000 at 25 frames/s; the AR loop stops at 10240 total positions (10240 - 1 = last decode position tested here)
usage_contract.prefill_input: embeddings [B, S, 4096] (any 1 <= S <= 10240; padded to 128/1024/next pow2 internally, chunked in 4096-token chunks above 4096, page table sliced per user)
usage_contract.decode_input: pre-embedded [B, 4096] (sum of semantic + residual embeddings * 8**-0.5), position per row
usage_contract.outputs: final-RMSNorm hidden [B, 4096] and logits [B, 200000] (bf16 on device, fp32 on host)

dtype_policy.name: optimized (tt/llm.py DTYPE_POLICIES; pipeline preset POLICY_PRESETS['optimized'])
dtype_policy.source: stage 07 datatype sweep, doc/optimize/README.md; 'functional' (stage 02-06) is kept as a named policy

math_fidelity.note: LI_FF1_FF3 / LI_FF2 are shared by prefill and decode in tt_transformers, so the prefill MLP also runs LoFi

other_components.depth_decoder: bfp8 transformer weights (wqkv, wo, gate/up/down, projection, fused heads), bf16 embedding / position / norm / selectors, HiFi2 fp32-acc, explicit 1D-mcast program configs for N <= 6144
other_components.flow_dit: bfp8 block matmul weights (wqkv, wo, ff_in, ff_out), bf16 norms / biases / folded in-out projections, HiFi2 with fp16 accumulation, SDPA HiFi4 256-wide chunks (S_pad % 256 == 0) else 128, one trace per window shape
other_components.vocoder: host torch fp32 (the TTNN port is 2.3x slower, doc/optimize/README.md), overlapped with the next window's denoising

device.board: p300c (one chip of a P300x2 host, TT_METAL_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0, PCI 0000:01:00.0)
device.trace_region_note: stage 07: backbone decode trace + depth traces + one 36-layer DiT step trace per window shape (200 MB; 90 MB sufficed for the AR traces alone)

kv_cache.page_table: identity [2, 320] int32; user u owns blocks [320u, 320u+320); blocks 640..703 are shared prefill scratch for padded positions past 10240 (prompts longer than 8192)
kv_cache.comment: 8 KV heads x 128 head_dim x 1.0625 B (bfp8: 1024 mantissa bytes + 64 exponent bytes per 32x32 tile) x 2 (K and V) = 2176 B per token per layer; 10240 tokens x 2 users x 36 layers + 64 scratch blocks = 1.76 GB resident (3.32 GB in the stage-02 bf16 cache). Weights: ~7.3 GB decoder (bfp8 attention 42 MB + bfp8 MLP 160 MB per layer) + 1.64 GB bf16 embedding + 0.82 GB bfp8 LM head; whole pipeline resident 15.1 GB of 32.6 GB DRAM (21.7 GB in the functional policy).

boundaries_covered: golden prompt 104 (padded to 128) vs HF and vs the stage-01 goldens
4992 and 5000 = maximum prompt (padded to 8192, chunked 2 x 4096, non-aligned) vs HF bf16 and fp32
10240 = whole context as prompt (padded to 16384, 3 executed chunks, scratch blocks) run-only
prefill.coverage_note: 5000 is the AR loop's own prompt cap (_MAX_PROMPT_TOKENS in diffusers encoders.py), so it is the largest prefill the pipeline ever issues; 10240 proves the path runs for any logical length up to the context. PCC values are in doc/llm/pcc/pcc_results.json (gate + slow test), doc/llm/pcc/long_prompt_control.json (fp32 control) and the debug log quoted in doc/llm/README.md (4000 / 4992).

decode.coverage_note: Decode at the last position of the advertised context (10239) runs through the same traced graph after the 5000-token prefill; its numerics are not reference-checked (an HF 10k-token reference is out of budget). The 5000-position step is checked against HF bf16 and fp32 (long_prompt_control.json).

pcc.note: Layer 0 vs the fp32 stage-01 goldens: prefill 0.99985 / 0.99990 (users 0/1), decode 0.99992. Full stack vs HF bf16: prefill hidden 0.9990, logits 0.9986; teacher-forced decode (8 frames) hidden 0.9985-0.9996, logits 0.9924-0.9994. Long realistic prompt (golden prompt repeated to 5000 tokens): row 0 hidden 0.982 vs fp32 / 0.984 vs bf16 while HF bf16 itself is 0.997 vs fp32, logits 0.998, decode step at 5000 hidden 0.989 / logits 0.998; row 1 all >= 0.99. The excess over the bf16 reference noise is length-dependent and only partly recovered by bf16 activations (probe policy); classified and handed to the stage-07 dtype sweep, see doc/llm/README.md 'Long-prompt precision'.

decode_trace_contract.device_advanced_state: current_pos and rope idxs are incremented on device (ttnn.plus_one) inside the trace; host writes them only when the requested position differs from the device shadow
decode_trace_contract.per_step_host_work: one copy_host_to_device_tensor (or ttnn.copy for a device input) of the 256 KB input tile, one execute_trace, two readbacks (hidden 256 KB, logits 12.8 MB)
decode_trace_contract.outputs: hidden [1,1,32,4096] bf16 tile; logits [1,1,32,200000] bf16 row-major (untilized on device)

notes: No capability reduction: the advertised 10240 context is allocated (paged cache, 640 blocks of 32) and the last position 10239 is exercised by decode.
Prefill is bounded by the pipeline's own 5000-token prompt cap, not by the device; longer prefills (up to 10240) would go through the same chunked path but are not tested.
Chunked prefill inherits the tt_transformers constraints: padded length a power of two >= 2048 when chunked, one-row page table per user, user_id 0 inside the chunk.
The RVQ depth decoder, the DiT and the vocoder are separate stages; this contract covers only the Qwen3 backbone.

Prefill of a 5000-token realistic prompt is within 0.982-0.999 hidden PCC of HF (fp32); the length-dependent part of the error is a precision (not a chunking) effect and is handed to the stage-07 datatype sweep with the fp32 control as baseline.

Stage 07: the KV cache is bfp8 (paged_fill_cache receives typecast K/V, paged_update_cache receives bf16 - tt_transformers' own fill / update path); the context stays 10240 positions, prefill / decode lengths unchanged (all stage 02-06 tests rerun green under the optimized pipeline default: doc/optimize/README.md).

Stage 07: every trace (backbone decode, depth seed / step, DiT Euler step for the 200-frame window) is captured after all weights and persistent buffers exist; DiT traces for other window shapes are captured per song and released with their RoPE / mask / selector tensors at the end of the song (FlowTransformer.clear_caches(keep_latents=...)).
